name: Olympians: Darius
source:
Mithras, aka Darius, is the newest member of your superhero team, "Olympians," founded and formed by the superhero agency, Olympus, to be a united front against any and all who stand against them.

As a former villain turned hero, you don't think he means harm, but it's clear he doesn't take being a hero all that seriously. 

So it's up to either gently urge him to do his job or kick his ass in gear.

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/olympians-darius]itch.io[/url]]
